summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Sara Farnya] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [October 23, 2024]:**  
- Discussed implementation options for well-being report distribution in the Matter project.  
- Presented two options: survey with custom URLs (quick but limited) and page activity (intuitive but requires app update).  
- Recommended using Avicenna IDs and the second option for better user experience.  
- *Key quote:* "*We highly recommend using the Avicenna IDs and choosing the second option if possible, as it will greatly enhance the user experience.*"  

- **[Camilla Michalski] (Happiness Research Institute) – [October 23, 2024]:**  
- Out of office until October 25.  

- **[Micah Kaats] (Ph.D. Candidate, Harvard University) – [October 23, 2024]:**  
- Asked if implementing option #2 would cause complications for enrolled participants.  
- Suggested starting implementation for readiness by the end of the pilot study.  
- Confirmed Avicenna IDs would be used.  
- *Key quote:* "*If we went with number #2 and it two weeks to implement, would it cause complications for users who are already enrolled in the study and responding to surveys when we launch that feature?*"  

- **[Amin Tavassolian] (Avicenna Research) – [October 24, 2024]:**  
- Clarified that option #2 would not affect the study; participants only need to update the app.  
- Explained app update process (auto-update or manual).  
- *Key quote:* "*No, the only thing they need to do is to update the app. Everything else would be seamless.*"  

- **[Sara Farnya] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [October 24, 2024]:**  
- Confirmed no complications for enrolled participants with option #2.  
- Agreed to start implementation for readiness by the end of the pilot study.  
- *Key quote:* "*Absolutely! I will go ahead and ask the team to start working on this.*"  

- **[Micah Kaats] (Ph.D. Candidate, Harvard University) – [October 24, 2024]:**  
- Expressed gratitude and requested updates.  
- Mentioned pilot launch the following week.  
- *Key quote:* "*Sounds great! Thanks so much Sara. Keep us posted with any updates.*"  

#### **2. Timeline**  
- **[October 23, 2024]:** Sara presents implementation options for well-being report distribution.  
- **[October 24, 2024]:** Micah confirms Avicenna IDs and discusses potential complications. Amin clarifies app update process. Sara agrees to start implementation.  
- **[October 25, 2024]:** Camilla Michalski returns from out of office.  
- **[Next Week (Pilot Launch)]:** Happiness Research Institute plans to launch the pilot.  

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**  
- **Implementation Options:** Survey with custom URLs vs. page activity hosted in-app.  
- **Feedback Submission:** Micah prefers option #2 if no complications arise.  
- **Access/Login Issues:** Participants need to update the app for option #2 (seamless process).  

#### **4. Action Items**  
- **Pending:**  
- Start implementation of option #2 (assigned to Avicenna Research team).  
- Pilot launch (assigned to Happiness Research Institute).  
- **Completed:**  
- Discussion and clarification of implementation options.  

#### **5. Technical Details (if applicable)**  
- **Account/Login Info:** Avicenna IDs will be used for participant identification.  
- **Study ID/Project Code:** Matter project.  

#### **6. Next Steps**  
- **Action 1:** Avicenna Research to begin implementation of option #2 (Sara Farnya).  
- **Action 2:** Happiness Research Institute to launch pilot and provide updates (Micah Kaats).
